criteria.description: Elaborate 4-pillar wedding Mandap with gold pillars, royal canopy arches, and draped fabric.
criteria.visual_observations: Four pillars and canopy are present but look flat and blocky with minimal architectural detailing and drape folds.
svg_fixes: Add <path d='...' fill='url(#gold)'> ornate curved architraves and tiered capitals atop pillars
Add flowing red and silk-gold draped curtains <path d='...' fill='url(#curtain)'> flanking the outer pillars
Add multi-layered floral marigold and jasmine garlands <path d='...' stroke='#FFA500'> cascading from canopy

criteria.description: Bride & Groom in traditional royal Indian wedding attire with clear silhouettes and detailed ornaments.
criteria.visual_observations: Figures are overly geometric and abstract cylinders lacking bridal jewelry, realistic folds, varmalas, and expressive silhouettes.
svg_fixes: Add detailed groom safa/turban with pleated folds <path d='...' fill='#DAA520'/> and ruby kalgi feather <path d='...' fill='#DC143C'/>
Add ornate bride lehenga with zardozi embroidery <path d='...' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2'/> and sheer red dupatta veil
Add varmala floral garlands <g id='varmala'> around both the bride and groom necks connecting gracefully
Add bride maang tikka <circle cx='512' cy='320' r='5' fill='#FFD700'/> and multi-strand pearl necklaces <ellipse rx='18' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#FFF' stroke-width='2'/>

criteria.description: Sacred Hawan/Agni Kund fire pit placed between the couple with radiant fire glow.
criteria.visual_observations: Fire pit is obscure and looks like an ambiguous white pillar rather than a stepped copper Hawan Kund with layered glowing flames.
svg_fixes: Replace center shape with a stepped copper Hawan Kund <polygon points='400,480 500,480 480,450 420,450' fill='#B87333'/>
Add dynamic layered flame paths <path d='M450,390 Q430,420 440,450 Q460,450 470,420 Z' fill='#FF4500'/> and inner gold flame <path d='...' fill='#FFD700'/> with glow filter

criteria.description: Rich festive Indian wedding ambiance including rangoli, glowing diyas, marigold torans, and celestial night sky.
criteria.visual_observations: Basic rangoli and a few diyas are present, but background needs warmer festive ambient glow, hanging lanterns, and richer floor petals.
svg_fixes: Add hanging brass temple bells and lanterns <g id='lanterns'> from mandap ceiling
Add glowing diyas with radial gradient halos <circle cx='...' cy='...' r='25' fill='url(#diyaGlow)'/>
Add scattered rose petals <ellipse rx='6' ry='3' fill='#C8102E'/> across the stage floor

criteria.description: Celebratory wedding banner text 'SHUBH VIVAH' with elegant typography and ornamental symbols.
criteria.visual_observations: Text is readable but simple brackets can be replaced by traditional Kalash or Paisley motifs with gold shine.
svg_fixes: Add decorative paisley/kalash ornament paths <path d='...' fill='#FFD700'/> flanking 'SHUBH VIVAH'
Change font-family to 'Cinzel', 'Georgia', serif with letter-spacing='6px' and gold gradient fill
